reason: Edge is based on intraday price action, gappers spiking then fading within the first 25-30 minutes and throughout the day on small-cap penny stocks.

universe.description: US small caps / penny stocks below $200M market cap, gappers >20%

setup.quote: if you see every single small cap that has been doing a gap over 20%

entry.rule: Long first stage of framework or backside bounces; short extension/fade after 9:50 peak
entry.quote: in the first stage of the framework, I would be a long basis penetrator

stop.rule: Dynamic levels with share recycling; avoid sizing into 1000% runners
stop.quote: I recycle shares a lot because I divide the trade in levels

exits.rule: Scale out on range; hold core only on high-conviction first red days
exits.quote: the trades that I trust the most are the first red days

sizing.rule: Scale in/out dynamically; size up only on high-conviction setups after experience
sizing.quote: how do I know that this set up is the one that I'm going to be sized in

market_filter.rule: Avoid hot sectors for shorts; favor volatility with many 50-200% runners
market_filter.quote: if you see a lot of 50%, 100%, 200% runners, that's crazy stuff for me

ambiguities.issue: Mentions both long and short but 60% short bias
ambiguities.assumption: Still intraday_only as all rules are time-of-day specific
